_comment: Links the HR roster (employees.xlsx) to the app's licence registry and to the ML dataset. Edit this file, not the code, when departments, projects or tools change. The server re-reads it when it changes.

admin.label: Admin (Head)
admin.summary: Full access: every department, project, licence and cost; registry changes, fulfilment, budgets, approval limits and final sign-off.

deptHead.label: Department Head
deptHead.summary: Department-wide access and permissions: decides access requests, manages the department's seats and allocations, approves recommendations and project changes for the department.

projectLead.label: Project Head
projectLead.summary: Project timelines, phase demand and the project team's licence access; proposes project changes and runs schedule what-ifs for own projects.

engineer.label: Engineer
engineer.summary: Licences assigned to them, availability of their tools, their own access requests and the assistant.

app_users._comment: Employee_ID -> person in the app's sample dataset, so records already seeded for that person stay theirs.
